title: Senior Product Manager - Fiat Payment Operations
location: Bulgaria, Poland, Spain, Malta, South Africa
description: <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p>BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.</p> <p>We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.</p> <p><strong>Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.</strong></p> <p>Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.</p> <p>By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.</p> <p>We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.</p> <p>We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:</p> <ul> <li>CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)</li> <li>FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)</li> <li>Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)</li> <li>LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong>: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy.</p> <p><strong>FUNCTION:</strong> Product</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Fiat product team and own the operational backbone of our fiat payment flows.</p> <p>Every day, BVNK moves money for enterprise customers across SEPA, SWIFT, ACH, RTGS and instant payment schemes. Getting a payment out of the door is only half the job. What happens next (a return, a recall, a rejected payment, a compliance hold, an investigation or a customer query) is where trust is won or lost. Your mission is to make those processes fast, reliable, automated and compliant, at scale.</p> <p>You'll own the product strategy for the post-initiation and exception lifecycle of fiat payments: returns, recalls, rejections, repairs, investigations, compliance-driven holds and releases, and the tooling our operations teams use to manage them. You'll work hand in hand with payment operations, compliance, financial crime, treasury, finance and our banking partners to turn manual processes into well-designed product capabilities.</p> <p>You'll partner with senior product managers, engineers and architects and with small, autonomous engineering squads, and you'll take products from discovery and design all the way through to launch. We see AI as a key lever in how we build and operate, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.</p> <p><strong>Key Areas of Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the product strategy and roadmap for FIAT payment operations, covering the full exception lifecycle of payment flows across all schemes we support: SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst), SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments.</li> <li>Design and deliver scheme-compliant handling of returns, recalls, rejections, cancellations, payment repairs and investigations, including the related ISO 20022 messages (e.g. pacs.004, camt.056, camt.029) and their equivalents on non-ISO rails.</li> <li>Build compliance processes into payment flows from the start: sanctions and transaction screening outcomes, holds and releases, Requests for Information (RFIs), Verification of Payee / Confirmation of Payee, Travel Rule and fraud-related recalls, working closely with Operation, compliance and financial crime teams.</li> <li>Drive straight-through processing and automation. Reduce manual intervention, define clear exception queues and SLAs, and give operations teams the internal tools, workflows and visibility they need.</li> <li>Ensure the ledger, reconciliation, treasury and reporting stay correct when a payment changes state, so funds are reversed, returned or re-credited accurately and customers are informed through clear API events, webhooks and statuses.</li> <li>Run the full product lifecycle from discovery to launch: problem definition, user research with internal and external users, solution design, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, delivery with engineering, launch readiness, go-to-market, pricing input, documentation and enablement for sales and support.</li> <li>Work with banking partners and scheme providers to understand rulebooks, cut-offs and scheme changes, and translate them into product requirements. Keep BVNK ahead of regulatory and scheme updates.</li> <li>Define and track the measures that matter, such as exception rates, time to resolve returns and recalls, recall success rates, STP rates, operational cost per transaction, SLA adherence and customer satisfaction. Use data to decide what to build next.</li> <li>Make sure capabilities are built once, on one shared BVNK platform, so every scheme, entity and partner benefits.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we need from you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Several years of product management experience, including owning complex B2B products in payments or fintech end-to-end, from discovery and design through to launch and commercialisation.</li> <li>Solid knowledge of a product framework you've applied in practice: discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, go-to-market and post-launch iteration.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with fiat payment schemes such as SEPA, SEPA Instant, SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments, and a deep understanding of how payments behave after initiation.</li> <li>Experience with payment operations processes: returns, recalls, rejections, investigations, exceptions and reconciliation. You know the scheme rules, reason codes and timelines, and you know where things break in practice.</li> <li>A track record of building compliance- and operations-heavy products in regulated environments, working closely with compliance, financial crime and operations teams on topics such as sanctions screening, payment holds, RFIs and fraud.</li> <li>Strong technical skills. You're comfortable working with engineers on APIs, ledgers, event-driven systems, payment messaging (ISO 20022, JSON), data models and integrations, and you can reason about technical trade-offs without needing to write the code.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills. You write clearly, present confidently to senior leaders, explain complex topics simply, and keep operations, compliance, engineering and commercial teams aligned.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity. You bring structure to complex, cross-functional problems and keep things moving.</li> <li>An AI-native mindset. You're an early adopter of AI tools and agentic workflows, and you use them to research, analyse, write specifications and design solutions, including spotting where AI can automate operational work.</li> <li>Bonus: experience building internal operations tooling, case management or workflow products.</li> <li>Bonus: experience working directly with sponsor banks, payment service providers or scheme operators.</li> <li>Bonus: experience with products that run across several regulated entities or jurisdictions (e.g. UK, EU, US).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you can expect from us:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fair and<strong> competitive salary </strong>at every stage of your growth</li> <li><strong>Flexible</strong> working hours, with hybrid working at its heart</li> <li>A <strong>culture</strong> built on passionate, growth-minded people</li> <li>A <strong>flexible</strong> approach to holiday</li> <li>Opportunities to travel to our <strong>offices around the world</strong></li> <li>An <strong>open and creative environment</strong> where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets.</li> </ul> <p><em>At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.</em></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.</p></div><div class="title">Bulgaria Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€100.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.</p></div><div class="title">Spain Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€120.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.</p></div><div class="title">Malta Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€75.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€110.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.</p></div><div class="title">Poland Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>330 000 zł</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>420 000 zł PLN</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Android Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience +<em> </em>Incentive Awards tied to your performance<em> </em> + benefits <br>Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>About our Mobile Engineering discipline</strong></p> <p><strong>Our mobile engineers have a variety of different backgrounds</strong></p> <p>There are ~60 Android engineers at Monzo and we’re looking for more to join the team. We have several non-graduates; only some of us studied Computer Science; some of us have worked in huge companies; some have only ever worked in startups; others are former consultants. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you.</p> <p> <strong>Monzo works in small, interdisciplinary teams</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <p>We’re searching for <strong>product-focused Android engineers</strong> to evolve our native mobile app.<strong> </strong>You’ll take pride in building polished user experiences, and you’ll balance the need for well-tested resilient code with moving fast and iterating. </p> <p>You’ll be working on a product that is a part of day to day life for more than 11 million people already, and your work here will shape the way that people interact with their finances.</p> <p>As an Android Engineer at Monzo you'll work in a small, autonomous product squad alongside iOS Engineers, Backend Engineers, User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, QA Testers, and Data Scientists.</p> <p>You and your team will be responsible for an overall company goal, rather than building a specific feature - you'll have the opportunity to have impact on both <em>what</em> we build, and <em>how</em> we build it. Mobile engineers at Monzo work on everything from the personal banking product to customer support tools. We also have a small mobile platform squad dedicated to enabling other engineers to move faster.</p> <p>Every week we meet as an Android discipline to discuss tools, techniques, problems we're encountering across the company and work together to improve our codebase and processes.</p> <p>You'll report to an engineering manager who will meet with you every 1-2 weeks 1:1. They’re dedicated to helping you grow and develop as an engineer.</p> <h3>Our Android app</h3> <p>Our app is 100% Kotlin, built using MVVM (Model View ViewModel) and Coordinators, and modularised by product feature.</p> <p>We use RxJava, Retrofit and Moshi for API calls and Dagger for dependency injection. We’re starting to use Coroutines for most new features. Room is our choice for persistence, and we use repositories for interacting with data. We’ve built out our design system with Compose. </p> <p>We use GitHub Pull Requests to do code reviews, and write unit tests for our ViewModels, Coordinators, and any other classes which contain logic. We write tests for all of our Compose screens and snapshot test them with Happo. We also use Espresso to test flows, which are executed via our continuous integration system.</p> <p>We’ve previously written about <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2019/02/11/building-monzo-chat-on-android">building Monzo Chat</a> on Android, which goes into detail on some of these elements.</p> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You care about the impact your work has on our customers, and optimise for outcomes rather than the number of lines of code you output</li> <li>You’re excited about and have experience in programming in Kotlin</li> <li>You’ve shipped and iterated on at least one app in the Play Store</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>You love turning excellent design into beautiful products</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>You have an understanding computer science principles</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you:</strong></h3> <p>💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience +<em> </em>Incentive Awards tied to your performance<em> </em> + benefits </p> <p>📍Barcelona, ESP</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of €1,200 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <h3><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></h3> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview including a system design and a behavioural interview </li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 2-3 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>There’s a detailed blog on <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/22/preparing-for-mobile-interviews-at-monzo">the interview process</a>, for extra details, hints and tips.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, we'll work with you to find a start date. In some cases, there might be a delay in when you can be released from your current role so that we can make sure things continue to run smoothly. We’ll be sure to communicate this with you and keep you updated.</p> <div id="1740415782.814699" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1740415782.814699"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">LI-JS1</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience +<em> </em>Incentive Awards tied to your performance<em> </em> + benefits <br>Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office</p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p>We have over 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.</p> <p>We contribute to <a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a> as much as possible. Our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong>is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p>This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! </p> <p>Together you’ll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider <em>collectives</em> (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are; Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion.</p> <p>They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! </p> <p>Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework</a> - we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: </p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial <a href="https://tour.golang.org/welcome/1"><strong>here</strong></a>)</li> <li><a href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a> for our asynchronous message queue</li> <li><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a> to schedule and run our services </li> <li><a href="https://www.envoyproxy.io/"><strong>Envoy Proxy</strong></a> for RPC</li> <li><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/"><strong>AWS</strong></a> for most of our production infrastructure and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/"> <strong>GCP</strong></a> for most of our data infrastructure</li> <li>React for our public web apps and internal tools</li> <li>We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> <li>Take home task or pair coding exercise </li> <li>Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview </li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. </p> <p>One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a>.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience +<em> </em>Incentive Awards tied to your performance<em> </em> + benefits </p> <p>📍Barcelona, Spain</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of €1,200 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-JS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>
